name: Camera Pose Gradient Computation
aliases: Gradient computation for camera pose optimization
Jacobian of Gaussians w.r.t. Camera Poses
definition: Computes the gradient of the rendering loss $\mathcal{L}$ with respect to virtual camera poses $\mathbf{T}_i$ to enable joint optimization of 3D Gaussians and camera trajectories.
summary: Camera Pose Gradient Computation derives the analytical Jacobian of Gaussian means with respect to camera poses, enabling joint optimization of 3D Gaussian parameters and camera trajectories.
